sections.title: The polyanalytic Bergman space in the model case of the unit disk with constant weight
sections.extract: For $q=1,2,3,\ldots$, we consider the spaces $\mathrm{PA}^2_q({\mathbb D}):=\mathrm{PA}^2_q({\mathbb D},\pi^{-1})$ where the domain is the unit disk ${\mathbb D}$ and the weight is $\omega(z)\equiv1/\pi$. The corresponding reproducing kernel $K_q$ was obtained Koshelev [@koselev]: $$K_q(z,w)=q\sum_{j=0}^{q-1}(-1)^j\binom{q}{j+1}\binom{q+j}{q} \frac{(1-w\bar z)^{q-j-1}|z-w|^{2j}}{(1-z\bar w)^{q+j+1}}.

sections.title: Asymptotic analysis of weighted polyanalytic Bergman kernels
sections.extract: It is our aim is to supply an algorithm to compute a near-diagonal asymptotic expansion of the weighted polyanalytic Bergman kernel $K_{q,m}$ as $m$ tends to infinity.
